PaneId.description: Pane identity within a surface. Normative model: globally unique numeric pane IDs scoped to the entire surface instance.

ProfileControlledEventType.description: Event types that are governed by eventProfile. Excludes lifecycle events (surface and pane lifecycle) which are always active and never appear in activeEvents.

oneOf.description: Selection point variant (reserved for v2 unless explicitly negotiated). v1 providers MAY receive this but MUST ignore when no v2 selection negotiation is active.
Selection region variant (reserved for v2 unless explicitly negotiated). v1 providers MAY receive this but MUST ignore when no v2 selection negotiation is active.

paired.description: true if the surface currently has an ownership lock, whether or not the owner socket is presently live. New providers need explicit takeover while locked.

takeover.description: Explicit ownership transfer request. Normal reconnect/resume by the current owner MUST NOT rely on takeover.

paneId.description: Target pane. Required — CLU must always specify which pane to target.
Target pane. Required — CLU must always specify which pane to target.

Target pane. Required — CLU must always specify which pane to target.

activeEvents.description: Profile-controlled events active for this session. Surface and pane lifecycle events are excluded — they are always active regardless of profile.

resumeGraceMs.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Implementations MAY advertise a preferred owner-resume retry budget in ms, but ownership lock itself does not auto-expire; another provider still requires explicit takeover or prior relinquish.

contentId.description: The content payload identity applied by this mutation. Required. Present (non-null) on content.set responses. Null on content.clear responses.

name.description: Extension-assigned human-readable name for this pane, or null if none.

count.description: Total pane count after split, including the source pane.

newPaneIds.description: Extension-assigned pane IDs for the newly created panes. Must contain exactly count - 1 entries.

newPaneLabels.description: Extension-assigned visible pane labels for the newly created panes. Must contain exactly count - 1 entries.

panes.description: All panes in the window after the split, including pre-existing panes. The source pane retains its original paneId and appears first.

name.description: New human-readable name for the pane, or null to clear an existing name.

closedFramesDiscarded.description: Count of unread closed annotation frames dropped from the provider buffer for this pane. CLU can use this to know what was lost.

parentPaneId.description: The pane that was split to produce this new pane, or null if created standalone.

fromSplit.description: true when this pane was created as part of a pane.split operation.
